title: Introducing...DOKBOX
subtitle: The world's greatest collection of documentaries
author: Dokbox
body:
We're thrilled to introduce you to DOKBOX- your new favourite streaming service. If you love documentaries, DOKBOX is all you need to explore the world from the comfort of your own home.

If you love the IAI's big ideas, you're going to love the big stories on Dokbox. And you can have both with one easy subscription with the IAI & DOKBOX tier.

What is DOKBOX?

DOKBOX is a new streaming service, bringing you thousands of documentary shows and feature length films.

You can learn about the moments that changed the course of human history, or discover the innovations that will define our future; explore the animal world, or the art world; change your lifestyle, or peer into the lives of the rich and famous.

If it matters, it’s on DOKBOX.

Every job has its risks, but most don't put you in the middle of the world's most dangerous conflicts. The Webby-Award Winning #Conflict is now showing on DOKBOX.

How do I use DOKBOX?

Once you’ve signed up for a DOKBOX account you’re ready to start exploring.

Login at DOKBOX.tv, browse the latest releases, or start exploring the channels.

Add shows you like to your List to watch later, or simple dive in and start soaking up stories from around the world.

Even accelerating in advances in technology can't illuminate human error. Find out how the Checklist Manifesto might do just that. Checklist, showing now on Dokbox.

How much does DOKBOX cost?

DOKBOX membership comes in three tiers – Basic, Standard and Premium. You can find our more about these at DOKBOX.tv.

Or, for the very best deal, you can include access to DOKBOX with your IAI.tv subscription. The IAI & DOKBOXtier gives you access to everything on offer from both IAI.tv and DOKBOX.tv, and saves you nearly £40 a year. Click here to find our more.

If you’re already an IAI subscriber, stay tuned for some very special offers for existing IAI subscribers.
